eps.ov: Koyuki Tanaka is in a dead end. At age 14, he has lost his passion for life. But a casual meeting of Koyuki with a young musician named Ryusuke is about to open a new path in front of him.
eps.oa: «كويوكي تاناكا» في طريق مسدود. ففي الرابعة عشرة فقد شغفه بالحياة. لكن لقاءً عابراً بموسيقي شاب اسمه «ريوسكي» يوشك أن يفتح أمامه طريقاً جديداً.

eps.ov: When Koyuki accepts Ryusuke's invitation to see his band perform live, he unwittingly sets down a path of self-discovery. But what Koyuki finds both disturbs and intrigues him, as the youngster uncovers the best and worst aspects of human nature.
eps.oa: حين يقبل «كويوكي» دعوة «ريوسكي» لمشاهدة فرقته على المسرح، يسلك من غير أن يدري طريقاً لاكتشاف ذاته. لكن ما يجده يقلقه ويثير فضوله معاً، إذ يكتشف الفتى أفضل ما في الطبيعة البشرية وأسوأه.

eps.ov: Koyuki hangs out with Ryusuke and finds out more about music, and meets his sister, Maho, who later takes Koyuki to see Beck, her brother's dog.
eps.oa: يقضي «كويوكي» وقتاً مع «ريوسكي» فيعرف المزيد عن الموسيقى، ويلقى أخته «ماهو»، فتأخذه لاحقاً ليرى «بيك»، كلب أخيها.

eps.ov: While Koyuki takes his first tentative steps toward learning guitar, Maho suggests that he'd be the perfect lead vocalist for Ryusuke's new band. But an accident threatens to shatter Ryusuke and Koyuki's friendship forever, as well as putting an end to Koyuki's musical aspirations-until help comes from a very unexpected source.
eps.oa: بينما يخطو «كويوكي» خطواته الأولى المترددة في تعلم الغيتار، تقترح «ماهو» أن يكون المغني الرئيسي المثالي لفرقة «ريوسكي» الجديدة. لكن حادثاً يهدد بأن يحطم صداقة ريوسكي وكويوكي إلى الأبد، وبأن ينهي طموحات كويوكي الموسيقية، حتى يأتيه العون من حيث لا يتوقع أبداً.

eps.ov: Koyuki's guitar training is coming along slowly but surely, until Saitou decides to speed things up by entering him to play in the annual summer festival! Meanwhile, Ryusuke and Chiba put their heads together to come up with a name for their new band.
eps.oa: يتقدم تدريب «كويوكي» على الغيتار ببطء لكن بثبات، حتى يقرر «سايتو» أن يسرّع الأمور فيسجله ليعزف في مهرجان الصيف السنوي! وفي الأثناء يتشاور «ريوسكي» و«تشيبا» ليختارا اسماً لفرقتهما الجديدة.

eps.ov: Taira, the newest member of Beck and the others have their first session together to start the band off on a good note. Koyuki's teacher is on maternity leave and a new cute teacher is introduced. As coordinator of the choir contest, she wants Koyuki to be the leader for the class to get them ready for the contest.
eps.oa: يعقد «تايرا»، أحدث أعضاء «بيك»، أول جلسة عزف مع الآخرين لتبدأ الفرقة بداية طيبة. وتأخذ معلمة «كويوكي» إجازة أمومة، فتأتي معلمة جديدة لطيفة، وهي المشرفة على مسابقة الكورال، فتريد أن يقود كويوكي الصف ليستعد للمسابقة.

eps.ov: Koyuki tries to memorize the scales at Saitou's place. Later we can see Koyuki talking with the bullies and then scolded in the teacher's office. Maho meets with him, and at Saitou's place, Koyuki tells her why he started to work for the old man.

Koyuki visits an instrument shop and practices some more. The school year ends. Next Momoko meets Koyuki accidentally going in Saitou's place and decides to go with him to check whether he works there. Koyuki tries to sell off Saitou's pornographic magazines.
Koyuki and Saku become friends. Koyuki gets nominated for the most difficult swimming races in the school's competition. Koyuki takes Saku to see Beck's show.
Koyuki and Saku become friends. Koyuki gets nominated for the most difficult swimming races in the school's competition. Koyuki takes Saku to see Beck's show.

The band tries to raise some money and Chiba finds out that Dying Breed is coming to Japan. Later on Koyuki talks to a teacher about his decreasing grades. Momoko asks the band to enter the school festival.

Dying Breed performs in concert live in Japan, with Koyuki unexpectedly guest singing. Later on, Koyuki and Izumi meet again and she invites him for night-swimming, much to Maho's chagrin when she finds out.

Ryusuke's been bothered by Erica Blige's death and often checks the news. At school, Saku and Koyuki form a band for the cultural festival with Tanabe and a bassist. Tanabe names the band Ciel Bleu. Hyodo tries to ruin Ciel Bleu's practice.
Mitty brings the cover design for the Beck band logo. Izumi meets up with Maho to clear the misunderstanding between them.
Koyuki tries to learn for his exams, but it doesn't go well. At school there's a rumor about Momoko working in a lingerie pub.

Gordie comes to see Eddie about the stolen stuff including Prudence. Then Eddie and Ryusuke talk about it on the phone. Koyuki still works hard to earn cash for the Telecaster and we can see a girl who works next door for the second time. At school, Tanaka finds out that one of Maho's friends is quite famous. Beck performs and is heard by Chicagoan records agent, named Frank Albin, allowing for a possible big break.
Ryusuke wants to release Beck's album in America. Koyuki finally buys the Telecaster. Koyuki sees at school the same girl, named Hiromi, who he saw in the doughnut store next to his workplace.

Koyuki talks with his boss about his band. Saku then joins Koyuki at Saito's swimming practice. Beck is allowed to perform at the Marquee's evening show as Hitode's support, because the manager really liked Koyuki's singing.
Ryusuke (along with Beck and Prudence) get kidnapped by Sykes, who takes him to meet his uncle, the bluesman John Lee Davis, who wanted to know who had stolen Prudence.
At the fishing pond the band talks with Kazuo about Greatful Sound. She wants Ryusuke to ask Eddie to come. Ryusuke agrees, but he also wants Beck to play although Ran is strongly against it.
Ryusuke talks with Chiba and Taira about his talk with Sykes. Back at school, Hiromi talks with Koyuki and Saku about playing guitar.
The band tries to improve the new song and Koyuki tries to write the lyrics, at Ryusuke's request. Saito tries to help Koyuki come up with some lyrics.
The Greatful Sound festival is on, with Belle Ame on the primary stage, Malcolm (a Sykes-managed rapper) on the second stage, and Beck on the smallest third stage.
After the band seems to break up before their time on the third stage, the band is slowly reforming just in time to play their hearts out for the growing crowd.
As Beck's set finishes up, the reality that it's Beck's last performance finally sets in.
Koyuki plans to revive Beck and sets out to get the band together.
